summary.text: D.J. Johnson is a Republican state representative who has represented Kentucky House of Representatives District 13 since 2021 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
An Owensboro native and U.S. Army Reserve veteran, he chairs the Elections, Constitutional Amendments and Intergovernmental Affairs Committee.

paragraphs.text: D.J. Johnson was born in Owensboro, Kentucky, where he lives, and graduated from Apollo High School.
He served in the U.S. Army Reserve from 1979 to 1990, reaching the rank of captain, and earned a B.A. in communications from Western Kentucky University in 1979.
His career experience includes working as general manager of Midwest Rigging Supply.
Johnson served in the Kentucky House for District 13 in 2017-2018 and returned to the seat on January 1, 2021, as the successor to James Glenn Jr.

For 2025-2026 he chaired the Elections, Constitutional Amendments and Intergovernmental Affairs Committee and was assigned to the State Government, Natural Resources and Energy, and Veterans, Military Affairs, and Public Protection committees.
The Republican primary for his seat on May 19, 2026, was canceled.
